result:
Verified the three files in this release:

1. **src/auth.js** (new) — Correctly extracted session check and added token-based auth for the rota integration, properly reading the token from environment variables
2. **src/server.js** (modified) — Clean refactor using the new requireAuth middleware; all protected routes are guarded
3. **src/shifts.js** (modified) — listShifts now sorts by start time correctly using `.slice().sort()` to avoid mutation

Test suite passes, Node.js version requirement met, MVP scope unchanged, no external services added. The changes are focused and safe—approved for release this week.

Review verdict written to REVIEW.md.
